current.text: He is out with a broken foot. Experts expect him back between Thanksgiving and Christmas, and one beat writer says possibly 2027.
The Clippers are expected to ease him back slowly after he returns.
An expert thinks he would have been the starting center if he had been healthy to start the season, and another would have called him draftable.
Isaiah Jackson starts at center in preseason scrimmages, with Brook Lopez projected as the backup center. The Clippers say this is not guaranteed to continue.
Once healthy, he should take the starting center job by February and March at 24 or more minutes, which should be enough to matter for fantasy.
He is an IL stash with the upside of a top 70 run late in the season.
In an auction mock draft he went for 3 USD as the first nomination, while most managers would expect to get him for 1 USD later.
The Clippers have a good fantasy playoff schedule (4-3-4 games for a March 28 end) and one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league with 13.

durable.text: Long, athletic big man and shot blocker with some ball handling and a natural-looking shot form. He has added about 20 pounds of muscle.
His fantasy profile resembles Donovan Clingan's, but with better free throws.
He broke his foot late in the 2025-26 season.
He makes no threes and gets very few steals, both far below the league pool.
Clippers coach Ty Lue never plays his centers heavy minutes and often changes his rotation choices, which caps his ceiling.

note: Yahoo ranks him 425 with a 0 USD value, ESPN does not rank him, and he went undrafted in our league last season. In a 144-player draft he is at most a 1 USD final pick to hold in an IL slot. Do not chase him to the 3 USD he got in a mock. His last seven games of 2025-26 (7 points, 5 rebounds, 1.6 blocks in 17 minutes) and a good 4-3-4 playoff schedule show the late-season upside for builds that want blocks and FG% from a center. If he goes undrafted, watch his return date around Christmas and whether he takes the starting job from Isaiah Jackson and Brook Lopez by February.
